title: Violet Crown
description:
Violet Crown was a WGI PIO (Percussion Independent Open) group based in San Antonio. I auditioned and marched in the quad line for the fall 2019 to spring 2020 season, which was cut short by COVID.

The show was called Profile. It was about what the country was dealing with at the time: racism against Black Americans, the deportation of Latin Americans, Islamophobia, and a growing nationalistic right.
